title: Pan-Seared Australian Lamb Chops
description: A simple yet flavorful lamb dish, featuring Australian lamb chops seared in a hot skillet. The zesty and crunchy elements add a delightful contrast to the dish.
instructions: Season the lamb chops with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a hot skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, mix the zest and crunchy breadcrumbs in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture over the lamb chops.
Return the skillet to the stovetop and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are crispy.
